changelog:
- Expanded public sign-up support with new tools: `signupgenius_list_slots`, `signupgenius_claim_slot`, and `signupgenius_release_slot` for managing slots on any public sheet.
- Improved metadata tool: `signupgenius_get_public_signup` now returns sheet-level information only (no slots).
- Updated write operations: slot claims and releases require a two-step, confirmable flow, and support required custom fields.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- Updated documentation to reflect new tool behaviors and clarify usage of each tool.
summary: Read sign-up sheets, slot reports, and groups on SignUpGenius — and add members to your groups. Triggers on phrases like "check SignUpGenius", "what am I signed up for", "what slots are left for [event]", "available slots", "list my SignUpGenius groups", "add [person] to my [group] group", or any request involving SignUpGenius sign-ups, RSVPs, volunteer slots, potlucks, carpools, classroom helpers, or PTA/HOA/Scout/team sign-ups. Works against your own signed-in account; supports Pro key for full slot reports.
